question: In July 2022, the Ministry of Women and Child Development implemented a scheme called _________ formerly known as Child Protection Services (CPS) Scheme since 2009-10-for the welfare and rehabilitation of children.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mission Vatsalya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mission Vasalya** is a scheme implemented by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development **in July 2022 for the welfare and rehabilitation of children.
 
• It was previously known as the** Child Protection Services (CPS) Scheme**, which was operational since 2009-10.
 
• The scheme focuses on providing a safe and secure environment for children in need of care and protection.
 
• Mission Vatsalya aims to ensure that every child has access to education, health services, and opportunities for overall development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Protection Services (CPS) Scheme**

 
 
• Initially launched in 2009-10, the CPS Scheme aimed at providing institutional and non-institutional care to children in need.
 
• It included components such as child care institutions, adoption services, and emergency outreach services.
 
• The scheme was designed to ensure the comprehensive development and rehabilitation of children.
 
 
 
• **Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015**
 
 
• This act is a major legislative framework for ensuring the protection, care, and development of children in India.
 
• It provides guidelines for the establishment of Child Welfare Committees and Juvenile Justice Boards.
 
• The act emphasizes rehabilitation and social reintegration of children in conflict with the law.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)**
 
 
• ICDS is a flagship program of the Government of India aimed at improving the nutritional and health status of children aged 0-6 years.
 
• It provides services such as supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-ups, and preschool education.
 
• The program also focuses on the nutrition and health of pregnant and lactating mothers.
 
 
 
• **Mid-Day Meal Scheme**
 
 
• Launched in 1995, this scheme aims to enhance enrollment, retention, and attendance of children in schools by providing free meals.
 
• It targets children in primary and upper primary classes in government and government-aided schools.
 
• The scheme also aims to improve the nutritional status of school-going children.
